title: Roy Craig interview with Lewis Chase, who denies knowledge

tellings.quote: >> The following interview conducted by Roy Craig is with Lieutenant Colonel Lewis D. Chase, who is chief of the operations division at Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana.

plain: In 1967 an interviewer named Roy Craig recorded a talk with Lieutenant Colonel Lewis D. Chase, the officer in charge of operations at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, and in that talk Chase denies knowing about the matter he was asked about. A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas plays the tape for Michels, on an episode about a UFO he says shut down ten nuclear missiles. The recording opens with the words "the following interview conducted by Roy Craig is with Lieutenant Colonel Lewis D. Chase, who is chief of the operations division," and Salas brings it up because a denial from the base's operations chief bears on what the Air Force admitted at the time.
